Zuckerberg's AI Agent Experiment Sparks Debate on Safety vs. Progress

Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has launched an "personal AI agent" experiment, which Fortune reports suggests he is "outsourcing his thinking to AI." In parallel, The New York Times notes Zuckerberg appeared to criticize AI labs like Anthropic on social media. He reportedly stated that leading AI labs should prioritize safety over advancing their technology. This stance contrasts with a perceived focus on improving AI capabilities by some in the field.
